home.tagline:
Strategic designer
focused on giving
brands authority.
paragraphs: I'm a graphic and web designer based in Valencia. For more than five years I've worked in branding, digital design and web development, bringing together strategy, aesthetics and code.

My approach: understand what a brand needs, give it a solid visual identity and build the digital presence that backs it up. I don't design to decorate. I design so brands communicate, connect and grow.
I've worked with startups, small businesses and companies in Brazil and Spain. Always with the same principle: every piece has a reason.

home.focusText:
I look for clarity, coherence and purpose in every project.
I don't design for aesthetics - I design so brands communicate better.

jobs.text: Complete visual identities and the websites that support them, hand-coded in HTML, CSS and JavaScript. Print and digital pieces, creative direction for social media and end-to-end management of each project, from brief to delivery.
Landing pages and corporate websites focused on UX/UI and responsive design. Brand management for several clients at once and conversion-driven campaigns on Meta Ads and Google Ads.
Creative direction and production of corporate, product and event shoots. Professional editing and retouching in Lightroom and Photoshop.
